entertainment.title: Harry Styles Dresses as NYC ‘Pizza Rat,’ Gets Jalen Brunson Tribute at Final MSG Residency Show
entertainment.summary: The pop star marked the occasion with a Halloween tribute to one of the city's most infamous viral sensations.
entertainment.body:
Harry Styles gave fans a memorable sendoff at his final Together, Together residency show at New York’s Madison Square Garden .

On Saturday (Oct. 31), the 32-year-old pop superstar wrapped up the second night — and 30th show of his residency — with Harryween, dressing as the city’s infamous Pizza Rat.

The “As It Was” singer took the stage in a furry brown onesie complete with oversized pink ears, a long tail and black sunglasses, while carrying a giant foam slice of pizza. The costume appeared to pay homage to the viral 2015 video of a rat dragging a slice of pizza down the stairs of a New York City subway station.

Styles’ backing band joined in the Halloween festivities, dressing as other NYC staples, including a hot dog and a taxi cab.

The evening also featured a special tribute to Styles, with Madison Square Garden raising a commemorative banner to the arena’s rafters. New York Knicks captain and 2026 NBA Finals MVP Jalen Brunson presented the banner to the singer during the show. The Garden also unveiled a new “Defining Moments” exhibit on its sixth-floor, featuring memorabilia from Styles’ 10-week residency.

During the previous night’s Harryween show on Friday (Oct. 30), the Grammy winner opened the evening dressed as Elvis Presley, while his band and dancers dressed as different versions of Styles from throughout his career. He later changed into the outfit he wore for his 2010 X Factor audition and performed Stevie Wonder’s “Isn’t She Lovely,” the song that helped him advance to the next round of the competition at age 16.

Styles’ MSG run supported his fourth solo studio album, Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally. , which debuted at No. 1 on both the Billboard 200 and the Official U.K. Albums Chart.

Styles’ Together, Together tour will continue through August 2027 with a 25-date extension launching April 2 in Phoenix. The North American leg will include stops in Dallas, Los Angeles, Toronto, Atlanta and Chicago. The European leg begins July 2 in Berlin, with additional dates in Paris, Madrid, Rome and Dublin, before wrapping Aug. 28 with the third and final show at London’s Wembley Stadium.

entertainment.title: Harry Styles Goes Full Pizza Rat for Halloween at Final MSG Show, Jalen Brunson Makes Surprise Visit
entertainment.summary: The Hollywood Reporter was inside the arena Saturday night for night two of Styles' traditional "Harryween" concerts, where the musician gave an emotional farewell to his 30-show residency.
entertainment.body:
“I thought I would use this momentous occasion in my career to dress like a rodent,” Harry Styles said Saturday night, explaining his costume for the second night of his traditional “Harryween” concerts .

The singer’s Halloween getup was just one of the highlights of the final night of his 30-show run at Madison Square Garden , which also featured a surprise appearance by New York Knicks star Jalen Brunson , a new cover added to the setlist, his fiancée Zoë Kravitz in attendance and an emotional goodbye from Styles, as fans filled the sold-out arena in an array of creative costumes. Related Stories Movies 'You Can See Everything,' 'Clayface' Fighting for No. 1 in Quiet Halloween Weekend Lifestyle Heidi Klum Reveals This Year's (Very Bloody) Halloween Costume

For night two of Harryween, Styles dressed as “Pizza Rat,” wearing a full rat suit and bringing a pizza slice onstage as an accessory. The costume appeared to take inspiration from the viral 2015 “Pizza Rat” video, which showed a rat dragging a slice of pizza down the stairs of a New York City subway station. Styles fully committed to the look, even playing guitar with his rat-claw nails.

His bandmates also got in on the New York theme, dressing as city landmarks and icons, including the Statue of Liberty, Andy Warhol and Anna Wintour. The previous night’s Harryween concert saw Styles transform into Elvis Presley before changing into the outfit he wore for his 2010 The X Factor UK audition.

Concertgoers also embraced the Halloween spirit on Saturday, with The Hollywood Reporter spotting attendees dressed as Nikki from Curry Barker’s Obsession , painter Bob Ross, dancing lobsters and even Kravitz’s plastic takeout bag outfit with the words “have a nice day” — seemingly a nod to the bag in Styles’ “Aperture” music video.

Styles eventually had to make a costume change of his own, however, after finding the full rat suit too hot to perform in. He stayed on theme, swapping it for rat ears, a tail and an “I’m a rat” T-shirt.

The night’s biggest surprise came while Styles was in his second costume, when Brunson walked onstage to present the Grammy winner with a banner, celebrating his record-breaking 30-show run.

“I just wanted to appear and congratulate you on your 30th night,” Brunson said. “A couple weeks ago, Harry was so kind to join me and my team on our banner night, and I thought I, on behalf of MSG and the Knicks, would do the same.”

entertainment.title: Morgan Wallen, Garth Brooks, Taylor Swift & More Artists With Most Weeks at No. 1 on Top Country Albums Chart: Full List
entertainment.summary: Male solo artists dominate, though three female solo artists and two groups have also achieved the feat.
entertainment.body:
Morgan Wallen ’s I’m the Problem leads Billboard ‘s Top Country Albums chart (dated Nov. 7) for the 51st nonconsecutive week. This ups Wallen’s career tally of weeks at No. 1 to 237, allowing him to extend his lead as the artist with the most weeks at No. 1 in the chart’s 62-year history.

Wallen’s achievement is especially impressive because he has amassed this hefty total of weeks at No. 1 in such a short amount of time. He first topped the chart a little more than six years ago — on Aug. 15, 2020.

Top Country Albums originated as Hot Country Albums in the Jan. 11, 1964 issue of Billboard . Johnny Cash ’s Ring of Fire (The Best of Johnny Cash) headed the inaugural chart. The compilation was well-timed: “Ring of Fire” had headed Hot Country Songs for seven weeks the previous summer and had crossed over to reach the top 20 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The chart was named Hot Country LP’s from 1968 to 1984, when vinyl LPs were king.

Twenty-one artists have logged 50 or more weeks at No. 1 on Top Country Albums. Male solo artists dominate, as you might expect, though three female solo artists have achieved the feat, as have two groups. (One of those groups is an all-female group.) Only one Black artist has amassed 50 or more weeks at No. 1, though that may change as country becomes more inclusive.

Here’s a look at all artists who have topped Top Country Albums for 50 or more weeks.

Longest-running No. 1: When the Sun Goes Down (14 weeks in 2004)

Notes: Chesney’s tally of No. 1 albums includes two live albums, LIVE: Live Those Songs Again (2006) and Live in No Shoes Nation (2017).

entertainment.title: Rawayana Throws Venezuelan-Style Halloween Party in NYC, Feat. Guests Cheo Pardo & Yorghaki
entertainment.summary: Donning wigs and costumes, the trippy-pop band lit up Brooklyn's Barclays Center as part of their ¿Dónde Es El After? World Tour.
entertainment.body:
Rawayana brought a Venezuelan-style Halloween party to New York City’s Barclays Center on Saturday night (Oct. 31), entertaining a sold-out crowd with hits like “Uber,” “Feriado” and “Hora Loca.” The band members joined in the festivities in costume, with Beto sporting dreadlocks, Fofo wearing a short, sleek bob wig, Abeja rocking an ’80s-style hair-metal wig and Tony dressed as a woman.

The beloved trippy-pop band started their performance on the main stage, featuring a backdrop screen alternating tropical visuals with imagery inspired by the songs they were performing, accompanied by smoke columns and confetti. They later moved to a second stage in the middle of the audience, truly igniting the party with tracks like “Si Te Pica Es Porque Eres Tú,” “Que Rico PR” and “Veneka,” undoubtedly among the most enthusiastically sung along tracks of the night. For the latter, in collaboration with Akapellah, Beto proudly carried the Latin Grammy for best Latin electronic music performance they received in 2025.

As part of this set, two special guests thrilled the crowd: Cheo Pardo, a former member of Los Amigos Invisibles whom Beto introduced as “one of our great heroes, great influencers in our musical history,” delivered a masterful DJ set dressed as a priest, keeping the crowd’s energy at its peak with classics like “Qué Es Lo Que Tiene Esa Nena” by El General and “El Tiburón” by Proyecto Uno. Then there was Yorghaki, who initially went unnoticed wearing a Spider-Man costume until he removed his mask to reveal his identity, before performing his collab with Beéle “abusadOra.”

Among the close to 12,000-people crowd, Venezuelan flags were prominently waved, with many fans wearing outfits referencing the South American country, such as jerseys from the Leones del Caracas baseball team as well as from the national soccer team, known as La Vinotinto. Flags from Mexico, Puerto Rico and the Dominican Republic, among other Latin American nations, were also spotted.

But it wasn’t all about the party. In a particularly heartfelt moment, Beto sat among the crowd with his guitar to perform “Tonada Por Ella,” dedicating the moment to those affected by the twin earthquakes that struck Venezuela last June. He invited attendees to donate to Fundación El After, a nonprofit organization Rawayana established to aid long-term recovery efforts in their homeland. QR codes appeared on the screens, directing fans to the foundation’s website, with the message: “Donate with El After. Your donation will help bring kids back to school,” accompanied by images of school desks.

entertainment.title: My Chemical Romance Earns First No. 1 Album on Billboard 200 After ‘The Black Parade’ Reissue
entertainment.summary: The Black Parade ’s 20-year-wait to reach No. 1 is the longest ever for an album.
entertainment.body:
My Chemical Romance triumphs on the Billboard 200 chart, scoring its first No. 1 album, as The Black Parade jumps from No. 139 to No. 1 on the Nov. 7-dated chart, following the 20th anniversary deluxe reissue of the 2006 album. The set originally debuted and peaked at No. 2 upon its release and remained the band’s highest-charting album until this week.

The album was reissued in an array of configurations, and was available across more than 20 physical variants, with the expanded editions including bonus tracks. All versions of the album are combined for tracking and charting purposes. In the week ending Oct. 29, it earned 78,000 equivalent album units in the United States (up 653%) according to Luminate — largely driven by pure album sales (68,000, up 2,082%).

The group has celebrated the album on tour since July 2025, with a trek that is slated to wrap on Nov. 22 in Indonesia. Among the stops was a five-night stand at the Hollywood Bowl in Los Angeles this October.

The Black Parade ’s 20-year-wait to reach No. 1 is the longest ever for an album, surpassing the 15-year and nine-month wait for Toby Keith’s 35 Biggest Hits , following his death in 2024.

My Chemical Romance is the third act in 2026 to wait at least 10 years from a Billboard 200 chart debut to a first No. 1. The band went 22 years and four months from its debut with Three Cheers for Sweet Revenge (June 26, 2004-dated chart) until its first leader. In September, Jhené Aiko got her first No. 1 with Westside Whimsy — 12 years and 10 months after her debut in 2013. In February, Megadeth landed its first No. 1 with its self-titled set — nearly 40 years after the metal act’s chart debut in 1986.

The Billboard 200 chart ranks the most popular albums of the week in the U.S. based on multi-metric consumption as measured in equivalent album units, compiled by Luminate. Units comprise album sales, track equivalent albums (TEA) and streaming equivalent albums (SEA). Each unit equals one album sale, or 10 individual tracks sold from an album, or 2,500 ad-supported or 1,000 paid/subscription on-demand official audio and video streams generated by songs from an album. The new Nov. 7, 2026-dated chart will be posted in full on Billboard ‘s website on Nov. 3. For all chart news, follow @billboard and @billboardcharts on both X and Instagram.

Of The Black Parade ’s 78,000 equivalent album units earned in the latest tracking week, album sales comprise 68,000 (up 2,082%, it surges 29-1 on Top Album Sales for the group’s first week at No. 1), SEA units comprise 10,000 (up 34%, equaling 10.14 million on-demand official streams of the set’s tracks) and TEA units comprise a negligible sum. Vinyl purchases accounted for 42,000 of the album’s sales for the week — the band’s best week ever on vinyl. The album benefits from its availability across more than 20 physical variants on vinyl, CD and cassette, including signed editions.

entertainment.title: ‘Criminal Minds: Evolution’ Cast Reacts to Show’s Cancellation: “There’s So Many More Stories to Tell”

entertainment.title: ‘O.J.’s Accomplice’ Has Its Own ‘The Jinx’ Hot Mic Moment
entertainment.summary: The Peacock docuseries floats a forgotten yet compelling theory about the 1994 murders of Nicole Brown Simpson and Ronald Goldman.
entertainment.body:
OK, so we don’t quite get a Bob-Durst-at-the-urinal confession out of new Peacock documentary series OJ’s Accomplice , but directors Ari Mark ( Amy Bradley Is Missing ) and Sumit David ( Diddy: The Making of a Bad Boy ) captured an interesting hot-mic moment of their own during production.

The two-part docuseries resurfaces the somewhat forgotten alternative theory that O.J. Simpson was aided by another man in the 1994 slayings of the former football star’s ex-wife Nicole Brown Simpson and Ronald Goldman. (Simpson was acquitted in the double homicide, but counterpoint: be serious.) The front-running suspect in that alt theory is now Joey Ippolito, a former drug smuggler and friend of Simpson’s. Simpson and Ippolito are both deceased. Related Stories TV Matthew Weiner Out as Showrunner of Eddie Murphy Peacock Series After Clash With Producers TV Alexander Brothers Case Is a "Microcosm for a Lot of Questions about Sexual Assault," Says Doc Director

One of the key characters — and “characters” is definitely the right term for the participants in this particular project — in OJ’s Accomplice is Charlie Ehrlich, another friend of Simpson’s and another ex-con. Ehrlich sat for Ample Entertainment’s cameras at the strip club he manages, The Peppermint Hippo. As the conversation wrapped, David told Ehrlich that production would need to “get some B-roll,” and then both men headed to the bar. Ehrlich was still mic’d up — and now loosened up.

“You didn’t bring it up, so I’m not going to bring it up,” Ehrlich, who was still wearing a microphone pack and within camera’s frame, said to David from his stool.

“But yeah. I was very good friends with his brother Lou (Ippolito),” Ehrlich continued. “Do you know what Lou told me? He told me that a month before Joey died, he took him to Italy — took Joe to Italy. Joe admitted that he was involved [in the Simpson/Goldman murders].”

The Hollywood Reporter asked Mark if Ehrlich was aware that his audio was still being captured.

“He knew he was mic’d up,” Mark told The Hollywood Reporter . “What happens quite often is, you know, folks are mic’d up and get comfortable. I don’t think he had forgotten that he was mic’d up necessarily, but I think he probably started speaking more casually.”

Mark says he also believes Ehrlich knew the cameras were still rolling.
